cards.title: What stage 5 is
cards.text: Stage 4 is done. What comes first?
cards.why: The build order says all of these come next; it's a lot, so it goes a piece at a time.
cards.details:
More modules: Pierce, Orbit, Return, Grow, Haste, Split, Knock, Pull, Leech, Shrapnel, Trail, Echo... from the design list, a few at a time, each on all three casts.

Runes: modules that cast another spell on hit, on wall, on end, every second or on kill.

Between runs: what you keep (slots, unlocks) after a run.

options.label: More modules

cards.title: Where bosses fight
cards.text: The Hulk now arrives in the biggest room. Should a boss lock you into its room until one of you wins?
cards.why: A locked arena makes the fight a set piece with room to move; an open one lets you run and use the maze.
cards.pick: No lock. It starts in the biggest room and roams; the maze is part of the fight.
